Maze Rules

A square maze of cells and walls. Find the way from the start to the goal.

The rules

Walking
You start in the cell with the circle at the top left; the goal is the flag at the bottom right. Tap a cell next to you to step into it, or a cell further along a straight, open passage to walk there at once. Your way is drawn as a thick line.
Drawing with a finger
In the settings you can choose "Drawing with a finger": move your finger through the passages and the circle follows from cell to cell. Taps work as well.
Walls and going back
Walls cannot be crossed; a short note says so. Stepping back into the cell you came from takes it off your way, and a tap on any cell of your way goes back to it.
The goal
When you reach the flag the maze is solved. Every maze has exactly one way from the start to the goal.
Levels
Easy (for children): 6 x 6 cells with wide passages. Medium: 10 x 10. Hard: 15 x 15. Very hard: 20 x 20. Each level has five mazes, one after the other; each is made by the program from a fixed number, so it is the same every time.
Back and hint
"Back" takes one cell back. "Hint" marks the next three cells of the right way with dashed rings, also out of a dead end.
Several figures
In the settings you can choose "Several figures": two or three figures start in different places, each with its own goal - the child (filled circle) to the school (open circle), the dog (filled square) to the kennel (open square), the cat (filled triangle) to the basket (open triangle). Tap a figure or its button under the maze to choose it; the chosen one has a ring. Each figure has exactly one way to its goal. The maze is solved when all have arrived.
